head: ebdf5af
completed_by: coordinator after the R2 agent stopped at a usage limit; all fixes and docs were committed by R2 before the stop

findings.finding: Permutation/stratified nulls placed stimuli on outcome times (miscalibrated, p=0.001 under H0)
findings.decision: Event-study method v2: outcome (and borrowed density) events are not eligible stimulus positions; H0 calibration tests for permutation, stratified and block nulls. Stored v1 runs stay as historical records.

findings.finding: Budget/feature runs held the SQLite write lock during grid computation
findings.decision: Compute first, then store label run + run in one short transaction.

findings.finding: Full grid product materialized before the cap (memory exhaustion via HTTP)
findings.decision: Lazy deduplicated grid with early stop; totals from distinct axis sizes.

findings.finding: Projection eviction between refresh and read silently emptied analysis inputs
findings.decision: Reads in one snapshot re-checked for eviction; retry, then 503 / ProjectionNotFresh; never an empty stored run.

findings.finding: DNS rebinding passed the CSRF guard (Origin compared with Host)
findings.decision: Host allowlist: localhost, IP literals, EW_TRUSTED_HOSTS / EW_TRUSTED_ORIGINS; Origin checked against the allowlist. Named LAN host names need explicit configuration (documented in GETTING_STARTED).

findings.finding: EW_REQUIRE_TOKEN left data-bearing pages and report files open
findings.decision: All pages and report files need the token (session cookie for browsers); login form and static assets stay open.

findings.finding: Post-hoc re-tagging changed results without a preregistration deviation flag
findings.decision: Selection-drift and post-registration edit checks; surfaced in result and disclosure.
Rule time_budget.v3 with RULE_HISTORY entry; e2e expectations follow.

findings.finding: Exact Fraction arithmetic made two-sided normalized summaries very slow and uncounted
findings.decision: Integer cross-multiplication for extremes, fsum for displayed means, cost in the work estimate.

findings.finding: Import-plan heartbeat stopped after one failed renewal
findings.decision: Retry with backoff; stop only when the lease was taken over.

findings.finding: Unbounded numeric decoding options over HTTP
Block permutation wrapped a full block onto slot 0 with a partial last block
findings.decision: Full-block permutation; at least two full blocks required.

findings.finding: Synthetic fake model provider reachable over HTTP
Long recordings starting before the load margin lost confirmed time
findings.decision: Items loaded up to duration_lookback_s (default 24 h) when their declared duration reaches the window.

findings.finding: Each rejected token took the write lock
Disclosure undercounted theses without accepted evidence
findings.decision: Disclosure counts theses whose pointers reach only candidate/rejected items, next to theses without any pointer.

findings.finding: /api/timeline with assume_zone had the same eviction race
